summary: Frontend-only retest for the new nav split (Dashboard / Courses / Wrong answers), Courses page, and the new in-exam Calculator popup for DCS 5004. Navbar order, active-highlight, /courses semesters & 7-card grids, mode dialog, StudyChapters back-to-courses link, exam launch, calculator open/close/toggle/keyboard, and 10 arithmetic/scientific/trig/log test cases were all verified. One correctness bug found in the Calculator: scientific notation like 1540÷3E6 is parsed with wrong operator precedence and returns 513333333.3 instead of 5.1333E-4 (expected per spec). All other calculator cases (2×10^3=2000, log(1000)=3, cos(60)=0.5, √(25)=5, 1÷0.0005=2000, Ans reuse, '5×='→Error, 3 x²=9, π, keyboard 7+8 Enter=15, Escape clears) PASS. Exam flow after calculator use is unaffected (answered a question, state preserved).

ui_bugs.issue: Scientific-notation 'E' key maps to '*10**' which, due to JS operator precedence (** binds tighter than * and /), gives incorrect results when E appears in a denominator or chain. Example: '1540÷3E6' becomes '1540/3*10**6' and evaluates to 513333333.3 instead of the expected 5.1333E-4. Users entering 'a÷bEn' will silently get wildly wrong answers on physics calculations.

action_items: Fix Calculator 'E' handling so that 'aEb' is treated as a single scientific-notation literal, not a '*10**' sequence. Suggested fix in evaluate() in /app/frontend/src/components/Calculator.jsx: BEFORE the current MAP substitutions, replace any '<num>E<signed-int>' token with '(<num>e<signed-int>)', e.g. js = js.replace(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)E(-?\d+)/g, '($1e$2)'); then remove the ['E','*10**'] entry from MAP. This makes '1540÷3E6' → '1540/(3e6)' = 5.1333e-4 and keeps '2×10^3' working through the '^'→'**' path.
critical_code_review_comments: Calculator E operator precedence bug (above) is the only functional issue found this iteration.

Calculator.jsx is nicely self-contained; evaluate() uses new Function() which is safe here because input is restricted to calculator keys, but keyboard input also permits '(' and ')' etc. — still safe since no identifiers reach eval.

ExamRunner uses data-testid="end-exam-btn" and "end-exam-confirm-btn" (not "finish-exam-btn" for the top-right header 'End test' button). Both pathways exist (finish-exam-btn on the last question's Finish button, end-exam-btn in the header) — not a bug, just worth noting for future tests.

Dashboard testids differ slightly from the request spec: 'accuracy-chart' is actually 'subject-accuracy-chart', 'course-breakdown-table' is 'subject-breakdown'. The elements are present; consider aligning testids to the spec names for consistency, or update the spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav order Dashboard→Courses→Wrong answers verified; /courses has semester-sem1 (7 cards) and semester-sem2 (7 cards); mode dialog opens from subject cards; StudyChapters back-to-courses link reads 'Courses' and routes to /courses; Dashboard no longer has semester-sem1/sem2 sections but still has stats-overview, subject-accuracy-chart, activity-chart, subject-breakdown, recent-sessions, data-tools (export/import/reset). Only remaining issue: Calculator E (scientific notation) operator precedence — see action_items for one-line fix in Calculator.jsx.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/components/Calculator.jsx the MAP table rewrites user expression 'aEb' → 'a*10**b'. JavaScript evaluates '**' before '*' and '/', so '1540/3*10**6' = (1540/3)*(10**6) = 513333333.33 rather than 1540/(3*10**6) = 5.1333e-4 that the exam spec expects. Fix: replace scientific-notation tokens with a parenthesized JS literal before other substitutions, e.g. js = js.replace(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)E(-?\d+)/g, '($1e$2)') and remove the ['E','*10**'] entry from MAP. Reproduction: open any DCS 5004 exam → Calculator → press 1 5 4 0 ÷ 3 E 6 = → observe result '513333333.3' instead of '5.1333E-4'.
